list.title: European Sales Operations & Performance Manager
list.description:
Responsibilities:
•	Define and continuously evolve the operating models, standards and governance frameworks for Agency Partners and National Sales Companies across Europe.
•	Own partner governance, including decision rights, compliance, operating reviews, escalation management and risk mitigation.
•	Establish and govern customer ownership, lead management, opportunity management and attribution principles across partner-operated channels.
•	Lead operational readiness, onboarding and deployment activities for new partners, markets, products, services and business initiatives.
•	Ensure successful implementation and adoption of systems, tools, processes and customer journeys across partner-operated markets.
•	Build and execute partner enablement programmes, including training, certification, communications and operational support.
•	Own partner performance management through KPI frameworks, business reviews, audits, compliance assessments and corrective action plans.
•	Drive continuous improvement across partner channels to improve commercial performance, operational efficiency and customer experience outcomes.
list.requirement:
What we're looking for:
•	Proven experience leading dealer operations, agency operations, network performance, partner management or channel operations functions within automotive or other complex multi-site industries.
•	Strong track record designing and implementing partner operating models, governance frameworks and performance management systems.
•	Experience launching, scaling and managing partner-operated sales channels within a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
•	Deep understanding of retail operations, customer journeys, CRM processes, lead management and channel governance.
•	Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate performance insights into operational improvements and measurable business outcomes.
•	Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience working across senior internal leadership teams and external partner organisations.
•	Commercially minded, customer-focused and comfortable operating in ambiguity while building scalable solutions from first principles.

职位要求

2.3年以上中高端品牌汽车维修经验，1年以上电动汽车维修经验，具备低压电工证；
